                        |                           | MEETS EXPECTATIONS (2) | NOTES: THE CANDIDATE SHARED HIS EXPERIENCE HANDLING WARRANTY CLAIMS, WHERE CUSTOMERS WOULD OFTEN CONTACT SUPPORT TO REQUEST UPDATES ON CLAIMS THEY HAD PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED. THESE SITUATIONS WERE IMPORTANT BECAUSE CUSTOMERS WERE WAITING FOR A RESOLUTION, REPLACEMENT, OR REIMBURSEMENT RELATED TO THEIR WARRANTY COVERAGE. IN MANY CASES, CUSTOMERS BECAME FRUSTRATED WHEN THERE WERE DELAYS OR WHEN THEY DID NOT RECEIVE THE OUTCOME THEY WERE EXPECTING.  TO ADDRESS THESE CONCERNS, THE CANDIDATE WOULD FIRST REVIEW THE CLAIM DETAILS AND VERIFY ITS CURRENT STATUS. IF UPDATES WERE AVAILABLE, HE WOULD CLEARLY EXPLAIN THE PROGRESS OF THE CLAIM, THE NEXT STEPS INVOLVED, AND ANY ADDITIONAL ACTIONS REQUIRED BEFORE A FINAL DECISION COULD BE MADE. HE ENSURED THAT CUSTOMERS RECEIVED ACCURATE AND TRANSPARENT INFORMATION WHILE SETTING REALISTIC EXPECTATIONS THROUGHOUT THE PROCESS. HE ALSO REMAINED PATIENT AND PROFESSIONAL, ESPECIALLY WHEN DEALING WITH DISSATISFIED CUSTOMERS.  AS A RESULT, THE CANDIDATE WAS ABLE TO PROVIDE CUSTOMERS WITH CLEAR UPDATES REGARDING THEIR CLAIMS AND HELP THEM BETTER UNDERSTAND THE WARRANTY PROCESS. WHILE SOME CUSTOMERS REMAINED UNSATISFIED WHEN THE CLAIM OUTCOME WAS UNFAVORABLE OR WHEN ADDITIONAL WAITING TIME WAS REQUIRED, HE CONSISTENTLY MAINTAINED PROFESSIONALISM, DELIVERED ACCURATE INFORMATION, AND ENSURED THAT CUSTOMERS WERE INFORMED OF THEIR AVAILABLE OPTIONS AND THE CURRENT STATUS OF THEIR CLAIMS.+|
